2549: The holder of the title "Number Two," Afro is out to hunt down Justice, the man who killed his father for the rank of "Number One.
2550: A lightning-quick gun-fighter and current #1 fighter of the world, little is known of this reclusive warrior. The only thing known for sure is that he killed the prior top fighter in the world in a one-on-one duel -- that top fighter was the father of Afro Samurai.
2587: The white haired companion of Afro Samurai. Afro's herald, hype-man and a real trash-talker; Ninja Ninja bears witness to Afro Samurai's search for Justice. Ninja Ninja is a force of nature - mischievous, highly-strung and dangerously irresponsible.
8133: One of the orphan children raised and trained by the dojo master.
11780: Perhaps one of the most noble and tragic characters He is perhaps the only friend Afro Samurai has ever known.
14175: A young woman who specializes in the art of healing, Otsuru is an excellent cook and adores fireworks. She is the one who discovered Afro in the shrine after he lost the Number Two headband as a boy, and took him to Sword Master's dojo where he befriended Jinno.
19185: The leader of the Empty Seven, who believes that obtaining both headbands will lead to immortality and godhood. He has a golden robotic left arm, which he can switch out for a machine gun.
28458: Following the death of his father, Afro is found and taken in by the master of a Sword School.
29587: Rokutarou, Afro's father, was the Number One at the beginning of the series, who lost his title and life to Justice when he decapitated him.
40237: He is the brother of Hachiro and was with him in their first attack upon young Afro. Some time later, young Afro managed to interrogate him for the info on who has the Number Two Headband before killing him.
